text:
maria: Heads-up from vendor call: H200 firmware patch 1.2.3 caused perf regressions in quantized kernels. They've asked for an urgent rollback to 1.2.2 while they triage. This affects our H200 Dedicated pools and marketplace images.
kevin: how big is the regression? numbers?
linh: seen ~20% p99 latency increase on batch sizes >8 in our perf lab. Quick repro with `./run_infer --model h200-prod --batch 16`.
dave: Oof. Marketplace compliance requires images to match vendor GA. If vendor rolls back, will their CVE sign-off hold? legal/compliance might need a note.
kate: marketing: if we do a rollback, we need to pause any joint announcement referencing the new perf numbers. 10bd notice still applies.
partner-bot: Vendor notice: H200 firmware 1.2.3 rollback requested. Expected stabilization ETA 14 days. (link: https://vendor.example/notice/8765)
maria: immediate asks: 1) decision on marketplace image (kevin), 2) SI certification impact (linh), 3) fallback routing for Hosted/Dedicated (dave).
kevin: proposal: create a marketplace exception flag for images built against 1.2.2 with a note in SKU description: "firmware rollback in effect". That lets us push soft-listing to partners while vendor stabilizes. Must include exact firmware and kernel hashes.
linh: SI angle: integrators need a compatibility matrix update. If we publish 1.2.2 image, we must run a certification gate pass: 3 smoke tests + a perf sanity run. Can do within 72 hours if infra prioritized.
dave: routing: add a temporary routing rule: prefer B200-quantized variants for latency-sensitive routes in Dedicated pools where H200 p99 > 150ms. Quick config patch: `route-policy add fallback h200 -> b200-q8 when p99>150ms`
kate: marketing approves soft-listing with clear messaging. But product needs to sign off on wording. No press until vendor confirms final GA.
maria: risk register entry:
- Impact: delayed joint announcement, possible customer confusion
- Mitigation: exception SKU + soft-listing, routing fallback, SI cert sprint
- Owner: kevin (marketplace), linh (SI), dave (routing)
kevin: timeline suggestion:
- 2024-07-10 12:00: vendor rollback request received (this thread)
- 2024-07-11 09:00: marketplace exception image build + docs
- 2024-07-11 14:00: SI smoke cert run starts
- 2024-07-13 17:00: decision checkpoint: re-enable announcement or keep soft-listing
linh: add to timeline: integrator leads notified now. Will coordinate dry-run slots Fri/Sat.
dave: infra note: we'll need to tag Dedicated pool nodes for B200 preference; I'll open infra ticket and flag oncall.
maria: quick question: MI300 or Gaudi impacted?
partner-bot: Vendor feed: MI300 unaffected. Gaudi unaffected but driver v2 RC still on track next week.
kate: thanks. Marketing will draft fallback messaging: "Temporarily aligning images with vendor-recommended firmware to ensure stability; performance updates will follow."\eom: maria: Action items:
- kevin: create exception SKU + publish docs (due 2024-07-11 09:00)
- linh: run SI smoke + perf sanity (start 2024-07-11 14:00)
- dave: infra ticket for routing + pool tags (open now)
- maria: notify legal/compliance and update risk register (due EOD)
kevin: will patch SKU description and add `firmware:1.2.2` metadata field.
linh: will post cert results as follow-ups. If we see any behavior mismatch >1% token-loss, escalate immediately.
dave: infra ticket #INF-8891 opened. Assigning to oncall.
maria: cool. I'll loop vendor PMs and integrator leads. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
